risk_note: Admin 用户详情 订单 / 找回 / 提现 read-only tabs (apps/admin pages/users/**, texts/users.ts). Contracts adminListOrders (B1-10i), adminListClaims (B1-10j), listAdminWithdrawals (B2-09c), all merged. Tabs by permission: orders need order.view or user.lookup, claims order.claim or user.lookup, withdrawals withdraw.review or fund.view; a tab the account cannot read is not shown and not requested. Each list is mounted and requested only on first switch to its tab, always with user_id and page; 10403 shows no permission, other failures a retry of that list only; amounts via @couli/money admin format, status names from the dictionary. No URL tab state, no write calls, no payout or balance fields. Prerequisite test-changes F1-07ja (#2029) and F1-07jba (#2085) merged; no frozen test changed here. Rule tests written by an independent Claude in two rounds; Claude spec-test review r1 fail (1 S1 handled by F1-07jba, 3 S2), r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/1-2). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine verify-fast and browser green after rebasing on main. Adversarial money review by a fresh independent Claude r1 pass with no findings. Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass, no findings (read-only tabs; idempotency, partial refund and clock n/a); independent Claude because Codex is unavailable until 2026-11-02
